responsibility: Implements the -Winfinite-recursion warning pass on GIMPLE SSA CFGs. It performs a graph search from the function entry looking for any path to function exit that avoids recursive self-calls, treats longjmp, throw-like runtime helpers, siglongjmp, and noreturn calls as recursion-breaking exits, records recursive call sites when no escape exists, and emits the top-level infinite-recursion diagnostic with notes on the recursive calls found.
